lines.say: Your app froze at three A-M.
And something restarted it before anyone woke up.
lines.show: And something [restarted it] before anyone woke up.

lines.say: The trap? Running isn't the same as working.
lines.show: The trap? *Running* isn't the same as *working.*

lines.say: A frozen app still looks alive. Nothing crashed, so nothing restarts it.
lines.show: A frozen app still *looks alive.* Nothing crashed, so [nothing restarts it.]

lines.say: The fix? Keep asking it: are you okay?
lines.show: The fix? Keep asking it: *are you okay?*

lines.say: Like a nurse checking your pulse.
Every few seconds, it calls your app's health page. Three misses in a row? It restarts the app.
lines.show: Every few seconds, it calls your app's *health page.* Three misses in a row? [Restart.]

lines.say: A copy that's still starting up says: not yet. Traffic skips it until it is. Like a shop's closed sign.
lines.show: A copy still starting up says: *not yet.* Traffic [skips it] until it is. Like a shop's *closed sign.*

lines.say: So that three A-M freeze? Three missed pulses, one restart, and it was back before anyone woke up.
lines.show: So that *3 AM freeze?* Three missed pulses, one restart, and it was [back] before anyone woke up.

lines.say: In Kubernetes, these are called liveness and readiness probes. Just a few lines in your config.
lines.show: In *Kubernetes,* these are [liveness and readiness probes.] Just a few lines in your config.

lines.say: New to Kubernetes? That reel is on my profile.
lines.show: New to Kubernetes? That reel is *on my profile.*

lines.say: Follow for the rest of the series.
lines.show: [Follow] for the rest of the series.
